user_question: I want to test this new app for aiding my development of VoiceCoach-v2. I want to enhance the ability of Ollama prompts to guide the live conversation by tracking the sales script so Ollama can know where in the process the call is now and where it should go. To help with this sales script tracking I want to add a horizontal timeline above the Ai prompt window. using the new ParaThinker app, how can I duplicate what I would do with Claude Code, ie. ask claude to review my code and create a plan for implementing this new visual timeline to track the sales script?

detailed_response.overview: Perfect use case for testing your new ParaThinker app! Here's how to replicate what you'd do with Claude Code using your multi-AI interface for VoiceCoach V2 timeline enhancement.

steps.description: Open terminal and run: python launch_myui.py (uses clean port startup)
Enter your OpenRouter API key in the sidebar Configuration section
Click '🔄 Scan Project' button in sidebar to analyze your VoiceCoach-v2 codebase structure
Check the 'Include Context' checkbox so all AI models understand your current codebase
Select 4-6 models for diverse perspectives: DeepSeek V3.1 (code analysis), Claude Sonnet 4 (UI/UX design), Grok 4 (creative approaches), GLM 4.5  if(React/TypeScript patterns)
Choose Claude Sonnet 4 for synthesis (best for complex technical planning)

Paste the detailed prompt in sidebar textarea covering: PROJECT CONTEXT (Electron desktop app, React+TypeScript, Ollama integration), REQUIREMENT (horizontal timeline above AI prompt window), ANALYSIS NEEDED (architecture review, UI structure, sales script tracking), DELIVERABLE (implementation plan with file locations, UI/UX design, data flow, integration points)
Click '🚀 Start ParaThinker' to get 4-6 different AI perspectives on architecture, UI design patterns, data management, and integration approaches
Click '🚀 Run ParaThinker' to synthesize all perspectives into unified implementation plan
Examine results in expandable sections: Final Synthesis (comprehensive plan), Internal Paths (diverse reasoning), Path References (model citations), Full Output (raw responses)
Click '💾 Export ParaThinker Results' to save complete analysis as markdown file for reference
Use the synthesized implementation roadmap with specific file locations, component structure, and step-by-step guidance from multiple AI perspectives

detailed_response.suggested_prompt:
Analyze VoiceCoach V2 codebase and create implementation plan for horizontal sales script timeline:

PROJECT CONTEXT:
- VoiceCoach V2 is an Electron desktop app (React + TypeScript)
- Uses Ollama for real-time coaching during sales calls
- Located at: D:\Projects\Ai\VoiceCoach-v2\
- Current UI has AI prompt window for coaching
- Sales script tracking needed to guide Ollama's contextual advice

REQUIREMENT:
Add horizontal visual timeline above AI prompt window that:
1. Shows current position in sales script/process
2. Tracks conversation progress through sales stages
3. Helps Ollama understand "where we are" in the call
4. Provides visual context for both user and AI

ANALYSIS NEEDED:
1. Review existing VoiceCoach V2 architecture and UI structure
2. Identify where AI prompt window is located in codebase
3. Assess current sales script/stage tracking (if any exists)
4. Design timeline component integration approach
5. Plan data flow between timeline and Ollama prompts

DELIVERABLE:
Detailed implementation plan with:
- File locations and component structure
- UI/UX design for timeline placement
- Data management approach for script tracking
- Integration points with existing Ollama system
- Step-by-step implementation roadmap
